rules.statement: Each asset communicates one primary visual idea, one message hierarchy, and no more than one primary action.
Use a single strong room or product composition rather than a crowded product collage unless the format is explicitly a shoppable assortment.
Treat bleed, trim, color profile, stock, finishing, legal copy, and output resolution as job inputs validated by the production destination.
Use one official logo instance at a deliberate scale; avoid watermark repetition or oversized logo-as-decoration treatments.

composition.copyLimit: One headline, up to two short support lines, one action.
composition.adaptation: Recompose at each aspect ratio; do not merely center-crop.

composition.background: White, light neutral, or quiet room context.

composition.front: Centered official logo on white or heritage green.
composition.back: Left-aligned name and contact block with generous margins.
composition.type: Interface sans for identity and details; editorial serif is optional only for a short brand line.
composition.shape: Square printed corners unless the job specification requires otherwise.

composition.grid: Two to four products with matched scale and ample separation.
composition.constraint: Do not imply a set or scale relationship unless sourced.

evaluation.question: Is the main idea clear in under two seconds at intended viewing size?
Was each aspect ratio intentionally recomposed with protected text and focal areas?
Are destination-specific resolution, bleed, legal, and export requirements supplied and verified?
